scope: All saved C plus retained provider-discovered inventories; not a claim of all machine-code functions.
address_comparison: Default-space 0x entries compared numerically (leading zeroes removed); full provider records preserved unchanged.
unknowns: Provider discovery may miss, split or merge code; no percentage of all game functions is claimed.
Complete exports are not internal function inventories. REVIEW is not semantic completeness.
Unresolved C selectors are never counted as confirmed actual entries. Missing-confirmation sets can overlap such C.
Additional dependency DLLs and dynamic paths are outside these six corpus modules.
